entities.name: PMID:25085540
observations: Rat ovariectomy fracture-healing study found ERα:ERβ expression ratio correlated with BMP-2 (r=0.601, p=0.001); BMP-2 correlated with callus width (r=0.709, p<0.001) and area (r=0.588, p=0.001). Authors concluded a higher ratio favors callus formation; observational evidence does not establish causation.

entities.name: ER ratio and callus
observations: In ovariectomy-induced osteoporotic rat fracture healing, ERα:ERβ ratio correlated positively with BMP-2; BMP-2 correlated positively with callus dimensions. This supports an association, not a demonstrated causal effect of changing the receptor ratio.
